name: Binance Visa Card
summary: Binance Visa Card lets you spend crypto at 60+ million merchants worldwide. Earn up to 8% cashback in BNB based on your BNB holdings. Free issuance with zero transaction fees.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the Binance Visa Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Binance Visa Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
